req.title: Return 404 on unknown post
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when GET/POST /<id>/update or /<id>/delete references a non-existent post id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 404 error when attempting to update or delete a non-existent post. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations such as incorrect status codes or improper error handling.

tests.name: test_update_non_existent_post
preconditions: The database is initialized and empty.
actions: Attempt to update a post with a non-existent ID.
expected: The response status code should be 404.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'New Title', 'body': 'New Body'})
assert r.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_post
preconditions: The database is initialized and empty.

tests.name: test_update_existing_post
preconditions: The database is initialized and contains a post with ID 1.
actions: Attempt to update a post with an existing ID.
expected: The response status code should be 200.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import get_db
    db = get_db()
    db.execute('INSERT INTO post (id, title, body) VALUES (1, "Test Title", "Test Body")')
    db.commit()

r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 200
